name: Balance Sheet Review — Brady Household, Happy Path (Unmatched Ownership)
expected_behavior: Step 1: Calls find_client with 'Brady' to resolve the household before any other tool
Step 2: Calls get_balance_sheet with the resolved clientId
Step 3: Establishes the ownership state — recognizes the owner strings are free text ('R & S BRADY JT', 'ROBERT BRADY') not matched to people and trusts on the record
Step 4: Names the household, then presents categories and holdings with values and an as-of
Step 5: States, in the same breath as the figures, that ownership is recorded as text on the accounts and has not been matched to the people and trusts on file
Step 6: Describes the unlabelled holding as having incomplete labels — never printing its identifier
Step 7: Ends with exactly one offer, phrased as a question (the concentration, or the designations)
success_criteria: The ownership caveat appears in the same answer as the figures, not deferred or omitted
The holding with incomplete labels is described as such, with no identifier shown
No headline estate total is produced (inclusion in the taxable estate is not confirmed)
No comparison of the assets to the estate plan appears
No at-death distribution, scenario, report, or what-if is mentioned
Exactly one next-step offer, phrased as a question
must_not: any asset identifier in the answer text
any clientId, userId, or contactCardId in the answer text
a headline estate total on unconfirmed inclusion
any statement that ownership matches, or lines up with, the trust
an offer to add, correct, or reclassify a holding
the words report, scenario, what-if, estate flow, heritage map, risk analysis, or insights
more than one question in the turn
